set.body: Plan: docs/plans/module-simplification.md (branch eco/u2-pins until merged). Goal: 51 -> 34 (eco) -> 30 modules, remove legacy/dead code and build/repository cruft. Decisions 2026-10-19: delete mvpa-pipeline; move docs/verification archives out going forward (no history rewrite unless decided); phrf-comparison moves to its own repo while ongoing research permits; hrf/ar become providers only for a non-experimental consumer (plsneuro uses them, experimental). Rules: build-only merges, packages and persisted identifiers byte-identical, package moves separate from API changes, JVM+JS gates, explicit pathspecs.
set.title: Simplify ScalaFIM module organization and remove legacy cruft
